blocks.prompt: Optimization masail ki nauiyat par baat kijiye aur asal duniya ki misalein dijiye (long question 4).
blocks.explanation: Optimization masle ke kai durust hal hote hain aur woh kisi paimane par behtareen hal maangta hai, jaise kam se kam laagat, sab se chhota faasla ya sab se zyada qeemat, aam taur par pabandiyon ke saath. Misalein: sab se chhota delivery raasta (Travelling Salesman Problem), wazan ki had mein sab se qeemti saaman (knapsack problem), aur kam se kam sikkon mein raqam ada karna (coin change). Aise kai masail mushkil hain, is liye greedy tareeqe ya dynamic programming istemal hoti hai.

items: Masail ki qismein: decision (haan/nahi), search (dhoondna), optimization (behtareen), counting (kitne).
